mining: fixed initial 0.3 image + 0.7 text cosine; same-category fit-supervised images only
candidate_policy: unique batch targets plus all known fit positives; exclude own reference; add exactly 16 distinct per-query extras excluding batch targets and known positives; mask other queries' extras
positive_key: reference ID plus sorted whitespace-normalized captions, case preserved
checkpoint_selection: dev category mean Recall@10 then Recall@50; earliest tie
comparison: paired same seeds, initialization, batch order, optimizer and selection for all arms; hard versus random isolates hardness at equal candidate counts
evaluation_policy: fit and dev only; full train category gallery for retrieval; no holdout metrics or official val annotations
decision_policy: report all arms and seed variance; dev-only exploratory evidence cannot promote or replace deployed A2
known_limitation: unannotated valid matches may still be sampled as negatives; dev has already been used for model development
